Title: Clean and well organised
Review: The store was spotless and everything was easy to find. Aisles were wide and clearly labelled, and the homewares section had a great range.

Title: Friendly staff at the exchange counter
Review: I needed to return a jumper and the team member at the exchange counter was patient and helpful. The whole process took under five minutes.

Title: Long wait at checkout
Review: Only two registers were open on a Saturday afternoon and the queue wrapped around the aisle. Staff seemed stretched thin.

Title: Great kids section
Review: Lots of choice for kids clothing and toys. Prices were reasonable and there were plenty of sale items. Some shelves were a bit messy.

Title: Couldn't find anyone to help
Review: Spent ten minutes looking for a staff member to check stock on a lamp. Nobody was around in the homewares area.

Title: Good prices on bedding
Review: Picked up a quilt cover set and pillows at a really good price. Great quality for the money and a lovely display to browse.

Title: Self-serve checkouts are quick
Review: The self-serve checkouts made shopping fast and easy. One machine was out of order but the others worked fine.

Title: Click and collect was smooth
Review: Ordered online and picked up within an hour. The pickup staff were quick and friendly, and my order was exactly right.

Title: Messy fitting rooms
Review: Decent range of clothes but the fitting rooms were full of discarded items and there was no one tidying them.

Title: Helpful with a return
Review: Returned a faulty toaster without any hassle. The staff member was polite and processed the refund quickly.

Title: Car park was packed
Review: The store itself was fine but parking was a nightmare on the weekend. Allow extra time if you go on a Saturday.

Title: Staff attitude was disappointing
Review: The staff member at the register seemed annoyed to be there and barely acknowledged me. The store is nice but service could be much better.

Title: Fantastic toy sale
Review: Went in for the toy sale and found some brilliant bargains. Staff were happy to help me find specific items.

Title: Everything I needed in one trip
Review: Found groceries, a gift and some storage tubs all in one trip. Convenient, although a few items were out of stock.

Title: Always reliable
Review: A dependable place for everyday basics. The layout is easy to follow and prices are fair.
